events.text: Drift to the nearest works. If owned, roll and pay 10 times the dice.
Stand the fleet a round: pay each player 40.
Harbormaster's favor: keep this pass to leave the Brig free.
Friendly bosun: keep this pass to leave the Brig free.
Harvest feast: collect 15 from each player.
A strong current carries you forward 4 spaces.
Cargo sold at a premium: receive 180.
Book passage on the Northwind Ferry.
Storm damage: pay 30 per depot and 120 per port.
Fair winds carry you to Home Quay.
Launch day: collect 30 from each player.
Return to Home Quay to settle accounts.
Dock refit: pay 40 per depot and 130 per port.
Audit failed. Go directly to the Brig.
Caught smuggling. Go directly to the Brig.
A headwind pushes you back 3 spaces.
